data: What is the value of the red line at 20 pretrained layers?

The red line represents the performance of the +CopyTransformer model with increasing numbers of pretrained layers. The value of the red line at 20 pretrained layers can be estimated by looking at the y-axis value corresponding to the point where the x-axis is 20. From the figure, the red line appears to be around 0.38 at 20 pretrained layers.
